title.en: The Neighbor's End of the Post Line

desc.zh: 喀尔喀台站的过境文书屡屡迟误，通往卫拉特方向的干线各段都要真实的人手、驿马与款项才能接通。本朝先按时代与已有技艺在旧驿、铁路与电线之间择路整修，再与卫拉特核验台站、土地与商信诸务，最后商定由谁岁修这条共同线路；拒绝或有限接受也是有效的结局。
desc.en: Khalkha relay stations keep holding up transit papers, and every section of the line toward Oirat needs real staff, remounts and money before it can be joined. The court first picks between the old relay, a railway section and the wire according to era and researched technique, then audits the stations, the land and the merchant letters with Oirat, and finally settles who maintains the shared line; refusal or a limited acceptance is an equally valid ending.

desc.zh: 一纸调令在路上走了两个月才到台站。台站缺少人手与驿马，通往卫拉特方向的干线各段都需先核账：国库、已有铁路与线路技艺决定本段先修什么。
desc.en: An order took two months on the road to reach the station. Staff and remounts are short, and every section of the line toward Oirat must first be audited: the treasury, any existing railway and the researched techniques decide what is repaired first.

title.en: The Section the Neighbor Will Connect

desc.zh: 喀尔喀整修本段的消息传到卫拉特。卫拉特官署先要核对自家台站是否可堪衔接，然后决定出资修衔接段、只修到交界，还是不予接通；无论答复如何，喀尔喀的台站勘验都不会停摆。
desc.en: Word of Khalkha's repairs reaches Oirat. Its office must first confirm its own stations can take a joining section, then fund the section, build only to the border, or refuse the connection; whatever the answer, Khalkha's station audit does not pause.

desc.en: Merchants ask to attach their letters to the official relay; the old rule carries papers only. The court decides whether to open it, charging per cover and quickening trade news, or to keep the relay official and let merchants hire their own couriers. If the neighbor refused or is unreachable, the case closes directly as a limited connection.

writes: MGL stage 1506 or 1507 with pending, OIR pending when the line continues

desc.zh: 线路两边都要给个准话：全线通行、两地互收常例，还是只到交界交接、不入腹地。程度定下后，共同线路如何岁修也要有说法。
desc.en: Both ends must state the degree plainly: through traffic with standing fees on both sides, or a handover at the border only. Once the degree is set, the maintenance of the shared line needs its own answer.

events.immediate: { if = { limit = { ywc_t11_oir_delivery_1506 = yes } remove_variable = ywc_t11_pending if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_t11_popup_epoch } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t11_popup_epoch value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t11_popup_epoch add = 1 } save_scope_value_as = { name = ywc_t11_popup_epoch value = var:ywc_t11_popup_epoch } ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes } }

label.zh: 全线通行，两地互收常例
label.en: Open through traffic with standing fees on both ends

label.zh: 只到交界交接，不入腹地
label.en: Hand over at the border only; no through traffic inland

consequence_note.en: The handover stays at the border; Khalkha receives the limited proposal.

consequence_note.en: Records this decision; if the line sits unanswered for over half a year it lapses.

label.zh: 对方已另行办理，撤回此议
label.en: The line has moved on; withdraw the request

consequence_note.en: Withdraws the answer and clears only this pending record.

writes: MGL stage 1507 with proposed outcome and pending, popup epoch

desc.zh: 线路已成或已罢。岁修款由谁出、来例能否照此办理，都要落纸：共同出资须官署仍有人手经手；也可各修各段；若对方已不可联系，可按已付工款自行结案。两边档册各记同一份结果。
desc.en: The line is built or dropped. Who pays the yearly repair and whether the next case may follow the same terms must be written down: a shared fund needs a staffed administration; each side may also repair its own; if the partner is unreachable, the case closes by the paid work record. Both registers keep the same result.

events.immediate: { if = { limit = { ywc_t11_mgl_delivery_1507 = yes } remove_variable = ywc_t11_pending if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_t11_popup_epoch } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t11_popup_epoch value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t11_popup_epoch add = 1 } save_scope_value_as = { name = ywc_t11_popup_epoch value = var:ywc_t11_popup_epoch } ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes } }

consequence_note.zh: 共同岁修入册，来例可循，双方档册各记一份。
consequence_note.en: The shared repair fund is registered as repeatable, one copy on each side.

label.en: Maintain the own side only, without a shared fund
